Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. Accounts Assistant: Graduate degree in Commerce/Finance from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks. Knowledge of Tally ERP 9.0. Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint. Fluency in English, Hindi, and Assamese.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for FREMAA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for FREMAA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 06-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the FREMAA recruitment is 06 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: FREMAA has announced a total of 12 vacancies for the posts of IT Assistant, Accounts Assistant, and Field Assistants in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application for FREMAA Recruitment 2026 is to be submitted via email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the IT Assistant post?
faq.answer: The IT Assistant post offers a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 35,000 to Rs. 40,000, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Field Assistants post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Field Assistants post, candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution and possess fluency in English, Hindi, and Assamese.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts in FREMAA Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised by FREMAA are on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the agency.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for FREMAA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of FREMAA?
faq.answer: The official website of the Flood and River Erosion Management Agency of Assam (FREMAA) is www.fremaa.assam.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information about the agency and its activities.
